title.en: Vercel React Best Practices Skill for React and Next.js
title.zh: Vercel React Best Practices：React 与 Next.js 性能 Skill

description.en: Explore the Vercel React Best Practices skill: when to use its prioritized performance rules, what it covers, and what still needs measurement.
description.zh: 了解 Vercel React Best Practices Skill 如何按优先级检查 React、Next.js 性能，以及哪些结论仍需测量验证。

zh: Vercel React Best Practices
React 性能 Skill
Next.js 性能优化 Skill

title.en: Vercel React Best Practices: fix the costly patterns first
title.zh: Vercel React Best Practices：先处理代价最高的性能问题

description.en: A rule-based Skill for writing and reviewing React or Next.js code. It prioritizes data waterfalls and bundle size before lower-impact micro-optimizations.
description.zh: 用于编写和审查 React、Next.js 代码的规则型 Skill。它先关注数据请求瀑布和包体积，再处理影响较小的细节优化。

summary.en: The source organizes React and Next.js performance rules into eight impact-ranked categories. That makes it useful for a focused review of fetching, bundles, server rendering, client state, and re-renders—not a substitute for profiling a real page.
summary.zh: 原始规则按影响程度分成八类，覆盖请求、包体积、服务端渲染、客户端数据和重渲染。适合做有重点的代码审查，但不能替代真实页面的性能测量。

installNote.en: Installs the upstream Skill with the open Skills CLI; no Floatboat capability is implied.
installNote.zh: 通过开放的 Skills CLI 安装上游 Skill，不代表 Floatboat 内置该能力。

guideTitle.en: Choose a performance rule by impact, not fashion
guideTitle.zh: 按影响程度选择性能规则，而不是追逐技巧

guideIntro.en: The source ranks waterfalls and bundles above micro-optimizations. Tie each proposed edit to the page's actual fetch and render path.
guideIntro.zh: 原始规则把请求瀑布和包体积放在小幅优化之前。每项修改都应对应具体页面的请求与渲染链路。

ctaTitle.en: Keep the performance question next to the code
ctaTitle.zh: 把性能问题和代码改动放在一起看

ctaDescription.en: Bring your React files and review notes into Floatboat, then verify the important claims with your own measurements.
ctaDescription.zh: 把 React 文件和审查意见放进 Floatboat，重要的性能结论仍需用项目数据验证。

useCases.en: When to use React Best Practices
useCases.zh: 何时使用 React Best Practices

useCasesDescription.en: Use it when React code is being written, reviewed, or refactored and you need a prioritized checklist.
useCasesDescription.zh: 编写、审查或重构 React 代码时，用它建立有优先级的检查清单。

how.en: How the review moves from symptom to edit
how.zh: 如何从性能症状走到代码修改

howDescription.en: The Skill directs attention to high-impact categories, then the agent inspects the relevant code path.
howDescription.zh: 先按高影响类别定位问题，再检查相关代码路径。

title.en: A page loads data in a chain
title.zh: 页面请求一个接一个

body.en: Review whether independent requests can run in parallel, or whether an await can move into the branch that actually needs it.
body.zh: 检查独立请求是否能并行，以及 await 是否可以移到真正需要它的分支。

title.en: A client component ships too much code
title.zh: 客户端组件加载过多代码

body.en: Trace broad imports, heavy modules, and third-party scripts before adding another loading indicator.
body.zh: 先检查聚合导入、重型模块和第三方脚本，再决定是否需要加载提示。

title.en: A component repeats expensive work
title.zh: 组件反复做昂贵计算

body.en: Inspect state placement, derived values, and re-render triggers before applying memoization everywhere.
body.zh: 先找状态放置、派生值和重渲染触发点，不要在所有组件上盲目加 memo。

notFor.en: A guaranteed Lighthouse score; rules need measurement on the target app.
notFor.zh: 保证某个 Lighthouse 分数；规则必须在目标应用上测量验证。

notFor.en: Non-React projects without a relevant React or Next.js code path.
notFor.zh: 没有相关 React 或 Next.js 代码路径的项目。

title.en: What does the React performance Skill cover?
title.zh: 这个 React 性能 Skill 覆盖哪些问题？

body.en: Its eight groups span asynchronous waterfalls, bundle loading, server work, client fetching, re-renders, rendering, JavaScript cost, and advanced patterns. The categories are ordered so reviews start with likely larger wins.
body.zh: 八组规则涵盖异步瀑布、包体积、服务端工作、客户端请求、重渲染、渲染过程、JavaScript 开销和进阶模式。排序的目的，是让审查先处理可能影响更大的问题。

title.en: Is it a profiler or an automatic speed fix?
title.zh: 它是性能分析器或自动提速工具吗？

body.en: No. The SKILL.md provides instructions and references for an agent. It can suggest code changes, while before/after traces, network timings, and user-facing metrics must be checked in the project.
body.zh: 不是。SKILL.md 向 Agent 提供规则与参考资料；它能提出修改建议，但前后对比、网络时序和用户指标仍要在项目中检验。

prompt.en: Review this Next.js product page for request waterfalls and unnecessary client-side JavaScript. Rank the fixes and show the exact files.
prompt.zh: 检查这个 Next.js 产品页有没有请求瀑布和不必要的客户端 JavaScript，按影响排序并指出具体文件。

result.en: A useful review identifies the request chain or import responsible, proposes bounded edits, and separates measured findings from hypotheses.
result.zh: 合格的审查应指出具体请求链或导入，提出有限范围的修改，并区分已测量的问题与推测。

title.en: Identify the slow path
title.zh: 找出慢路径

body.en: Name the page or interaction and gather a trace or reproducible symptom.
body.zh: 锁定页面或交互，收集追踪结果或可复现的症状。

title.en: Apply the highest-impact rule
title.zh: 先用高影响规则

body.en: Read the relevant rule and inspect only the code that contributes to that path.
body.zh: 阅读相关规则，只检查影响该路径的代码。

title.en: Verify the result
title.zh: 验证结果

body.en: Compare behavior and measurements after the change; do not call a stylistic rewrite a performance win.
body.zh: 修改后比较行为和指标，不把风格改写当作性能收益。

en: A prioritized list of candidate fixes
A measurement plan for the main changes
zh: 按影响排序的候选修复
对应代码位置与规则
主要修改的测量计划

en: Confirm React/Next.js version before using version-specific advice.
Profile the affected route before and after edits.
zh: 使用版本相关建议前确认 React、Next.js 版本。
修改前后测量受影响路由。
保留原有行为与无障碍支持。

question.en: Is Vercel React Best Practices only for Next.js?
question.zh: Vercel React Best Practices 只能用于 Next.js 吗？

answer.en: No. Many rules concern React generally, while some sections address Next.js server rendering and routing. Apply only the rules that match your stack.
answer.zh: 不是。许多规则适用于 React 通用代码，部分章节针对 Next.js 服务端渲染和路由；只应用与当前技术栈匹配的规则。

question.en: Does it rewrite the whole app?
question.zh: 它会重写整个应用吗？

answer.en: It is a set of instructions for an agent, not an autonomous refactoring service. Scope the request to the route or component you want reviewed.
answer.zh: 它是给 Agent 的指令集，不是自动重构服务。应明确要审查的路由或组件。

question.en: How do I know a recommendation helped?
question.zh: 如何知道建议真的有效？

answer.en: Measure the same user path before and after. A rule match is a reason to investigate, not proof of a faster page.
answer.zh: 对同一用户路径做前后测量。命中规则代表值得调查，不等于页面已经变快。

question.en: Where are the original rules?
question.zh: 原始规则在哪里？

answer.en: The source SKILL.md links individual rule files in Vercel Labs' agent-skills repository; this page links the original source.
answer.zh: 原始 SKILL.md 位于 Vercel Labs 的 agent-skills 仓库，并指向各条规则文件；本页可直接打开来源。

title.en: Vercel Composition Patterns Skill for React Components
title.zh: Vercel Composition Patterns：React 组件组合模式 Skill

description.en: Learn how Vercel Composition Patterns guides React component API design, compound components, and state placement without boolean-prop overload.
description.zh: 了解 Vercel Composition Patterns 如何指导 React 组件 API、复合组件与状态放置，避免布尔属性不断膨胀。

zh: Vercel Composition Patterns
React 复合组件 Skill
React 组件架构

title.en: Vercel Composition Patterns: fewer switches, clearer components
title.zh: Vercel Composition Patterns：少一点开关，多一点清晰组合

description.en: This Skill helps redesign React components whose behavior is controlled by a growing list of boolean props. Its focus is composition, shared context, and explicit variants.
description.zh: 当 React 组件越来越依赖布尔属性控制行为时，这个 Skill 引导你改用组合、共享上下文与明确的变体。

summary.en: The source favors compound components and provider-owned state over prop combinations that multiply. It is most useful while designing a component library or untangling a component whose API is hard to reason about.
summary.zh: 原始规则主张用复合组件和 Provider 管理状态，而非让属性组合无限增加。它适合设计组件库，或梳理 API 已经难以理解的组件。

installNote.en: This is the upstream Skill installation command, not a Floatboat installer.
installNote.zh: 这是上游 Skill 的安装命令，不是 Floatboat 安装器。

guideTitle.zh: 先确定调用方需要组合什么

guideIntro.en: A better API exposes meaningful parts. The pattern choice should follow how the component is used, not a blanket ban on booleans.
guideIntro.zh: 更好的 API 应暴露有意义的部件。模式选择要看组件如何被使用，而不是机械禁止所有布尔属性。

ctaTitle.en: Keep the component contract visible during refactoring
ctaTitle.zh: 重构时让组件契约始终可见

ctaDescription.en: Bring the component, its call sites, and design constraints into one Floatboat task before changing the public API.
ctaDescription.zh: 修改公共 API 前，把组件、调用位置和设计约束放进同一个 Floatboat 任务。

useCases.zh: 哪些组件值得重新设计

useCasesDescription.en: Use this Skill when the component API has become difficult to use or extend.
useCasesDescription.zh: 当组件 API 难用、难扩展时再用它，而不是为每个简单组件增加抽象。

exclusions.en: Cases that do not need this refactor

how.en: How to reshape a component API
how.zh: 如何重新组织组件 API

howDescription.en: Start from real call sites, identify stable parts, then move shared behavior behind an explicit interface.
howDescription.zh: 从真实调用位置出发，找出稳定部件，再把共享行为放进明确的接口。

title.en: A dialog has too many boolean modes
title.zh: 弹窗有太多布尔模式

body.en: Replace combinations like compact, confirm, destructive, and showFooter with named compositions where behavior is visible at the call site.
body.zh: 把 compact、confirm、destructive、showFooter 等属性组合改成有名称的组件组合，让调用方看得出行为。

title.en: Sibling controls need the same state
title.zh: 兄弟控件需要共享状态

body.en: Place the state and actions in a provider rather than threading them through every intermediate component.
body.zh: 把状态与操作集中到 Provider，而不是逐层传给所有中间组件。

title.en: Consumers need controlled flexibility
title.zh: 组件库使用者需要可控的灵活性

body.en: Expose compound parts or explicit variants so consumers can assemble layouts without reimplementing internals.
body.zh: 提供复合部件或明确变体，让使用者能组合布局，同时不必重新实现内部逻辑。

notFor.en: A small component with one clear behavior and no API pressure.
notFor.zh: 行为单一、接口清楚且没有扩展压力的小组件。

notFor.en: A performance audit; composition can clarify APIs without making rendering faster.
notFor.zh: 性能审查；组合模式能让 API 更清晰，但不保证渲染更快。

title.en: What is the boolean-prop problem?
title.zh: 布尔属性过多会带来什么问题？

body.en: Each new switch can interact with existing switches, creating undocumented combinations. The Skill recommends making meaningful variants explicit or letting callers assemble compound parts.
body.zh: 每增加一个开关，都可能与已有开关产生新的组合。这个 Skill 建议把有意义的变体写明，或让调用方组合复合部件。

title.en: Does it require React 19?
title.zh: 必须使用 React 19 吗？

body.en: Most composition guidance is general React architecture. The source marks React 19-specific API advice separately; skip that section for React 18 or earlier.
body.zh: 大部分组合建议属于通用 React 架构。原文单独标记了 React 19 API 建议；React 18 及更早版本应跳过那部分。

prompt.en: Refactor this Modal with six boolean props into an API that supports confirm and edit flows without surprising combinations.
prompt.zh: 把这个带六个布尔属性的 Modal 重构成能支持确认和编辑流程、又不会出现意外组合的 API。

result.en: A useful proposal shows the new public API, one migrated call site, state ownership, and what happens to existing uses.
result.zh: 合格方案应展示新公共 API、一个迁移后的调用示例、状态归属，以及旧用法如何处理。

title.en: Inspect actual callers
title.zh: 检查真实调用方

body.en: List the combinations that exist today and those that should not be possible.
body.zh: 列出现有属性组合，以及本不应该存在的组合。

title.en: Choose parts and state owner
title.zh: 确定部件与状态归属

body.en: Use compound components or explicit variants; keep the provider responsible for shared state.
body.zh: 使用复合组件或明确变体，让 Provider 负责共享状态。

title.en: Migrate representative uses
title.zh: 迁移代表性用法

body.en: Convert common and edge call sites before removing the old API.
body.zh: 先迁移常见和边缘调用，再移除旧接口。

zh: 更小、更清晰的组件 API
明确的状态归属
有代表性的迁移示例

en: Do existing callers depend on undocumented combinations?
Are the new parts understandable without reading implementation?
zh: 现有调用是否依赖未文档化的属性组合？
不读实现代码也能看懂新部件吗？
React 19 专属建议适用于当前项目吗？

question.en: What are compound components?
question.zh: 什么是复合组件？

answer.en: They expose related parts under a shared component API, often with context to coordinate state, so callers can assemble the structure they need.
answer.zh: 它把相关部件放在同一套组件 API 下，通常通过上下文协调状态，让调用方按需要组合结构。

question.en: Should every boolean prop be removed?
question.zh: 所有布尔属性都要删除吗？

answer.en: No. The concern is proliferating behavior modes and unclear combinations. A simple flag can remain if it keeps the API clear.
answer.zh: 不用。问题在于行为模式膨胀和组合含义不清；如果一个简单开关依然清楚，就无需强行移除。

question.en: Will this Skill improve runtime performance?
question.zh: 这个 Skill 会提升运行性能吗？

answer.en: Its main goal is maintainable component architecture. Measure separately if performance is the reason for the refactor.
answer.zh: 它主要解决组件架构的可维护性。如果重构目的是性能提升，仍需单独测量。

question.en: Can React 18 projects use it?
question.zh: React 18 项目可以用吗？

answer.en: Yes for the general patterns; the source explicitly separates React 19-only guidance, which should not be applied to older versions.
answer.zh: 通用模式可以使用；原文单独标记了 React 19 专属建议，旧版本不应套用。

title.en: Vercel React Native Skills for Expo and Mobile Apps
title.zh: Vercel React Native Skills：Expo 与移动应用实践

description.en: See how Vercel's React Native Skill prioritizes list performance, animations, navigation, images, and native-platform patterns.
description.zh: 了解 Vercel React Native Skill 如何检查列表性能、动画、导航、图片和原生平台模式。

zh: Vercel React Native Skills
Expo 性能 Skill
React Native Agent Skill

title.en: React Native Skills: review the mobile bottlenecks
title.zh: React Native Skills：检查真正影响移动端体验的瓶颈

description.en: A React Native and Expo guidance Skill with priority on large lists, animation, navigation, media, and platform-specific choices.
description.zh: 面向 React Native 与 Expo 的指导型 Skill，优先关注大列表、动画、导航、媒体和平台差异。

summary.en: The source is a prioritized collection of mobile rules. It is particularly helpful where web-oriented React advice misses native list virtualization, gesture performance, safe areas, or image handling.
summary.zh: 原始文件按优先级整理移动端规则。面对列表虚拟化、手势性能、安全区域或图片处理时，普通 Web React 建议往往不够，这个 Skill 更对题。

kind.zh: 移动端实现与审查 Skill

installNote.en: Install through the upstream Skills CLI; this page does not install a mobile runtime.
installNote.zh: 通过上游 Skills CLI 安装指令；本页不会安装移动端运行环境。

guideTitle.en: Mobile rules should follow the bottleneck
guideTitle.zh: 按移动端瓶颈选择规则

guideIntro.en: The source ranks list work above cosmetic tweaks. Check the device and interaction before choosing a pattern.
guideIntro.zh: 原文把列表性能放在细节美化之前。先明确设备与交互，再选择合适模式。

ctaTitle.en: Keep device constraints beside your code review
ctaTitle.zh: 让设备约束和代码审查保持在一起

ctaDescription.en: Use Floatboat to work through the screen, device symptoms, and proposed changes; validate the result on real target devices.
ctaDescription.zh: 在 Floatboat 中整理页面、设备症状和修改建议，再到目标设备上验证结果。

useCases.en: When the React Native Skill helps
useCases.zh: React Native Skill 适用场景

useCasesDescription.en: Use mobile-specific rules when a screen's behavior depends on device rendering or native APIs.
useCasesDescription.zh: 当界面表现依赖设备渲染或原生 API 时，应使用移动端专属规则。

how.en: How to investigate a mobile screen

howDescription.en: Move from a reproduced device symptom to a relevant rule and a bounded change.
howDescription.zh: 从设备上复现的症状出发，选择相关规则并做有限修改。

title.en: Scrolling drops frames
title.zh: 滚动时掉帧

body.en: Inspect virtualization, item rendering, callback stability, and images before rewriting the whole screen.
body.zh: 先检查虚拟列表、条目渲染、回调稳定性与图片，不急着重写整个页面。

title.en: Gestures feel delayed
title.zh: 手势响应迟缓

body.en: Review whether an animation uses compositor-friendly properties and appropriate gesture primitives.
body.zh: 核对动画是否使用适合 GPU 的属性，以及手势是否采用合适的原语。

title.en: A screen behaves differently on iOS and Android
title.zh: 同一页面在 iOS 与 Android 表现不同

body.en: Check safe areas, native navigation, images, fonts, and platform APIs instead of assuming web layout behavior.
body.zh: 检查安全区域、原生导航、图片、字体和平台 API，不把网页布局经验直接套过去。

notFor.en: A browser-only React application; use React web guidance instead.
notFor.zh: 纯浏览器 React 应用；应优先使用 Web React 指南。

notFor.en: Proof that a screen performs well on every device; device testing is still required.
notFor.zh: 证明页面在所有设备上都流畅；仍需要设备测试。

title.en: How is this different from React Best Practices?
title.zh: 它和 React Best Practices 有什么不同？

body.en: This Skill addresses native and Expo decisions: virtualized lists, gestures, safe areas, native navigation, image handling, and native module structure. The web-focused React Skill emphasizes data waterfalls and browser bundles.
body.zh: 这个 Skill 处理原生与 Expo 特有问题：虚拟列表、手势、安全区域、原生导航、图片和原生模块结构。Web 版 React Skill 则更关注请求瀑布与浏览器包体积。

title.en: Does it include Expo-specific advice?
title.zh: 是否包含 Expo 的具体建议？

body.en: Yes. The source references Expo image handling and mobile configuration alongside general React Native patterns. Verify package and SDK versions before adopting a recommendation.
body.zh: 包含。原文除了 React Native 通用模式，也涉及 Expo 图片处理与移动端配置。采用建议前需要核对依赖包和 SDK 版本。

prompt.en: Review this Expo feed screen. Scrolling stutters on mid-range Android devices; identify the likely list and image bottlenecks.
prompt.zh: 检查这个 Expo 信息流页面。中端 Android 设备滚动卡顿，请定位列表和图片方面的可能瓶颈。

result.en: A useful answer identifies item-rendering and image paths, proposes scoped changes, and asks for device measurements before declaring a fix.
result.zh: 合格回答应指出条目渲染与图片路径，提出有边界的改动，并在声称修复前要求设备测量。

title.en: Reproduce on target hardware
title.zh: 在目标设备复现

body.en: Record the screen, platform, and gesture that shows the problem.
body.zh: 记录出问题的页面、平台与具体手势。

title.en: Read the matching mobile rules
title.zh: 查找对应的移动端规则

body.en: Prioritize list and animation categories when frame drops are the symptom.
body.zh: 如果症状是掉帧，先看列表与动画类规则。

title.en: Retest both platforms
title.zh: 重新测试两个平台

body.en: Check behavior and performance on the intended iOS and Android device range.
body.zh: 在目标 iOS、Android 设备范围内复核行为和性能。

zh: 移动端瓶颈短名单
限定范围的组件或配置改动
设备验证清单

en: Test the target device class, not only a simulator.
zh: 确认 Expo 与依赖版本。
测试目标设备档位，不只看模拟器。
检查无障碍与减少动态效果设置。

question.en: Is this for React Native or web React?
question.zh: 这是给 React Native 还是网页 React 用的？

answer.en: It targets React Native and Expo. For browser rendering, the separate Vercel React Best Practices Skill is a closer match.
answer.zh: 它面向 React Native 和 Expo；浏览器端渲染更适合使用单独的 Vercel React Best Practices Skill。

question.en: Will installing the Skill add Expo packages?
question.zh: 安装这个 Skill 会添加 Expo 依赖吗？

answer.en: No. It installs agent instructions. Code or dependency changes require a separate, explicit implementation task.
answer.zh: 不会。安装的是 Agent 指令；修改代码或依赖需要另行执行明确的实现任务。

question.en: Which issue should be checked first?
question.zh: 应该先检查哪类问题？

answer.en: The source puts list performance first. Start there when the symptom is scrolling jank, but follow the actual screen and device evidence.
answer.zh: 原文把列表性能列为最高优先级；滚动卡顿时可先从这里查，但仍以页面和设备证据为准。

question.en: Does it replace device testing?
question.zh: 它能代替真机测试吗？

answer.en: No. Rules help select changes; real iOS and Android testing determines whether the change improves the intended experience.
answer.zh: 不能。规则帮助选择改动；真实 iOS、Android 测试才能判断体验是否改善。

title.en: Vercel React View Transitions Skill for UI Animation
title.zh: Vercel React View Transitions：界面过渡动画 Skill

description.en: Understand the Vercel React View Transitions Skill for shared elements, route changes, list reordering, and reduced-motion decisions.
description.zh: 了解 Vercel React View Transitions Skill 如何处理共享元素、路由切换、列表重排与减少动态效果。

zh: Vercel React View Transitions
React 视图过渡 Skill
Next.js 页面过渡

title.en: React View Transitions: animate the relationship, not every click
title.zh: React View Transitions：动画应解释界面关系，而非装饰每次点击

description.en: A Skill for transitions between React UI states: shared elements, page changes, list identity, and content reveals—with guidance on when motion should stay silent.
description.zh: 用于 React 界面状态切换的 Skill，覆盖共享元素、页面变化、列表身份与内容出现，也说明什么时候应保持静默。

summary.en: The source ties animation patterns to spatial meaning. A list-to-detail movement may need a shared element; a background refresh often should not animate at all. Implementation advice is version-sensitive.
summary.zh: 原始指南把动画与空间含义对应起来：列表到详情可能需要共享元素，后台刷新却通常不应动。具体实现还受 React 与框架版本约束。

installNote.en: Installs upstream instructions, not an animation library or Floatboat feature.
installNote.zh: 安装的是上游指令，不是动画库或 Floatboat 功能。

guideTitle.zh: 选择能解释导航关系的动画

guideIntro.en: Shared identity, direction, and reveal each tell a different story. Check framework and browser support before implementation.
guideIntro.zh: 共享身份、方向和内容出现分别表达不同关系；实现前还要核对框架与浏览器支持。

ctaTitle.en: Discuss the transition with the actual screen in view
ctaTitle.zh: 对着真实界面讨论过渡动画

ctaDescription.en: Keep route structure, UI states, and accessibility checks together in Floatboat while you refine the interaction.
ctaDescription.zh: 在 Floatboat 中集中梳理路由结构、界面状态和无障碍检查，再打磨交互。

useCases.en: When view transitions earn their place
useCases.zh: 哪些地方值得加入视图过渡

useCasesDescription.en: Add motion where it helps people understand continuity or arrival.
useCasesDescription.zh: 只有在动画有助于理解连续性或内容到达时才加入。

how.en: How to choose a transition pattern

howDescription.en: Audit the relationship between states before touching CSS or transition APIs.
howDescription.zh: 先检查两个状态的关系，再处理 CSS 或过渡 API。

title.en: Open an item from a list
title.zh: 从列表打开详情

body.en: A named shared element can show that the detail view belongs to the card the user selected.
body.zh: 命名共享元素可以说明详情页来自用户刚刚点开的卡片。

title.en: Reorder persistent items
title.zh: 重排仍然存在的条目

body.en: Use stable item identity so motion communicates rearrangement rather than disappearance and reappearance.
body.zh: 保持条目身份稳定，让动画表达位置变化，而不是条目消失再出现。

title.en: Reveal content after Suspense
title.zh: Suspense 后显示内容

body.en: A restrained entrance can mark newly arrived content without animating every data refresh.
body.zh: 克制的进入动画可以提示新内容到达，而不必让每次数据刷新都产生动效。

notFor.en: Background revalidation that should not interrupt the user's focus.
notFor.zh: 不应打断用户注意力的后台重新验证。

notFor.en: Directional slides between unrelated tabs; they suggest a false hierarchy.
notFor.zh: 无层级关系的标签页之间使用定向滑动；这会暗示不存在的层级。

title.en: When is a shared-element transition appropriate?
title.zh: 何时适合使用共享元素过渡？

body.en: When the same conceptual item persists across views, such as a card opening its detail page. The source recommends using identity and direction to make that relationship legible, not adding movement for its own sake.
body.zh: 当同一个事物跨视图延续时，例如卡片打开详情页，共享元素能说明两者关系。原文强调身份和方向要有意义，而不是为了有动画而动画。

title.en: What should be checked before using React ViewTransition?
title.zh: 使用 React ViewTransition 前要检查什么？

body.en: Check the React and Next.js setup, browser behavior, transition triggers, and reduced-motion support. The source distinguishes Next.js's bundled React behavior from non-Next.js setups.
body.zh: 核对 React、Next.js 配置、浏览器表现、触发方式与减少动态效果支持。原文也区分了 Next.js 自带的 React 行为和其他 React 项目。

prompt.en: Make this gallery's card-to-detail navigation feel continuous, but leave tab switching and background refresh unobtrusive.
prompt.zh: 让画廊卡片到详情页的切换更连续，但不要让标签切换和后台刷新变得显眼。

result.en: A useful plan identifies the shared item, names its transition boundary, and states which changes intentionally have no animation.
result.zh: 合格方案会找出共享条目、明确过渡边界，并说明哪些状态变化刻意不加动画。

title.en: Map UI relationships
title.zh: 画出界面关系

body.en: Separate hierarchy, lateral navigation, reordering, and data reveal.
body.zh: 区分层级导航、横向切换、条目重排和数据到达。

title.en: Choose the matching trigger
title.zh: 选择对应触发方式

body.en: Use the source's React transition pattern for that relationship and version.
body.zh: 根据关系和版本，选择原文对应的 React 过渡模式。

title.en: Test motion and fallback
title.zh: 测试动效与降级

body.en: Check browser support, reduced motion, and behavior without animation.
body.zh: 检查浏览器支持、减少动态效果设置及无动画时的行为。

en: A transition map for UI states
zh: 界面状态的过渡关系图
有限范围的 React/CSS 实现
降级与减少动态效果检查项

en: Does motion communicate a real relationship?
Does the project's React version support the approach?
Is the screen usable when animation is skipped?
zh: 动画是否表达真实关系？
项目 React 版本是否支持该做法？
跳过动画后界面是否仍可用？

question.en: Does every route change need a transition?
question.zh: 每次路由变化都需要动画吗？

answer.en: No. The source says transitions should communicate spatial continuity. Unrelated or background changes may be clearer without motion.
answer.zh: 不用。原文强调过渡要说明空间连续性；无关切换或后台变化可能保持静态更清楚。

question.en: Is a third-party animation library required?
question.zh: 必须安装第三方动画库吗？

answer.en: The Skill focuses on React's ViewTransition API and CSS. Whether that API is available depends on your React and framework setup.
answer.zh: 这个 Skill 聚焦 React 的 ViewTransition API 与 CSS；能否使用仍取决于 React 和框架配置。

question.en: What about reduced-motion preferences?
question.zh: 如何处理减少动态效果偏好？

answer.en: Provide a usable no-motion path and test the user's reduced-motion setting; animation must not carry essential information alone.
answer.zh: 需要提供无动画也可用的路径，并测试用户的减少动态效果设置；关键内容不能只靠动画传达。

question.en: Can I use the same recipe in any React app?
question.zh: 所有 React 应用都能用同一套写法吗？

answer.en: No. The source distinguishes Next.js from non-Next.js availability and recommends following its version-specific implementation references.
answer.zh: 不能。原文区分 Next.js 与非 Next.js 的可用条件，应按版本阅读对应实现参考。

category.zh: 网页 UI · 设计审查

title.en: Vercel Web Design Guidelines Skill for UI Reviews
title.zh: Vercel Web Design Guidelines：网页 UI 审查 Skill

description.en: See how the Web Design Guidelines Skill reviews UI code for interface, accessibility, and UX issues against a freshly fetched source.
description.zh: 了解 Web Design Guidelines Skill 如何获取最新规范，并检查网页 UI、无障碍和交互问题。

zh: Web Design Guidelines Skill
网页 UI 审查 Skill
Vercel 界面规范

title.en: Web Design Guidelines: inspect the interface code
title.zh: Web Design Guidelines：从界面代码找出具体问题

description.en: A review Skill that fetches current Web Interface Guidelines, reads the files you name, and reports findings at file-and-line level.
description.zh: 一个审查型 Skill：先获取最新网页界面规范，再阅读指定文件，并按文件和行号报告问题。

summary.en: The installed SKILL.md is a short review workflow rather than a frozen rulebook. Its agent fetches the current guideline source for each review, checks the requested files, and returns terse findings.
summary.zh: 安装的 SKILL.md 是简短审查流程，不是固定不变的规则全集。Agent 每次先获取最新规范，再检查指定文件，并输出简洁的问题定位。

installNote.en: Upstream Skills CLI command. The Skill also fetches a separate live guideline source during review.
installNote.zh: 上游 Skills CLI 命令。实际审查时，该 Skill 还会从另一个来源获取最新规范。

guideTitle.zh: 把规范转成可定位的问题

guideIntro.en: The useful output is a file-and-line finding you can verify, not a generic redesign brief.
guideIntro.zh: 有价值的产出是能在文件和行号上核对的问题，不是泛泛的重新设计建议。

ctaTitle.en: Bring interface findings back to the task
ctaTitle.zh: 把界面问题带回当前任务

ctaDescription.en: Use Floatboat to keep the affected screen, source files, and proposed fixes together while you decide what to change.
ctaDescription.zh: 在 Floatboat 中放好受影响页面、源码和修复建议，再决定具体改动。

useCases.en: What to review with Web Design Guidelines
useCases.zh: Web Design Guidelines 适合审查什么

useCasesDescription.en: Point it at a concrete file set and an interface question.
useCasesDescription.zh: 给它具体文件范围和界面问题，结论才容易核实。

exclusions.en: What a code review cannot prove
exclusions.zh: 代码审查不能证明什么

how.zh: 界面规范审查如何进行

howDescription.en: The original workflow fetches current rules, inspects named files, then reports located findings.
howDescription.zh: 原始流程先获取当前规则，再检查指定文件，最后报告可定位的问题。

title.en: A form is hard to navigate by keyboard
title.zh: 表单难以使用键盘操作

body.en: Review labels, focus states, error messaging, and keyboard handlers in the relevant form files.
body.zh: 检查相关表单文件中的标签、焦点状态、错误信息和键盘处理。

title.en: A control behaves inconsistently
title.zh: 控件行为不一致

body.en: Inspect navigation state, touch targets, feedback, and interaction semantics rather than discussing visual taste alone.
body.zh: 检查导航状态、点击区域、反馈和交互语义，而不只讨论视觉喜好。

title.en: A new page needs a pre-release UI pass
title.zh: 新页面上线前需要 UI 复核

body.en: Scope the review to the new page and its shared components so findings map back to code owners.
body.zh: 把范围限定在新页面及其共享组件，让问题能够对应到负责的代码。

notFor.en: Visual proof that the rendered page looks right at every viewport.
notFor.zh: 证明渲染后的页面在所有视口都正确；仍需实际看页面。

notFor.en: An open-ended design concept without source files to inspect.
notFor.zh: 没有可检查源码的开放式视觉概念设计。

title.en: Where do the design rules come from?
title.zh: 设计检查规则来自哪里？

body.en: The SKILL.md instructs the agent to fetch the latest Web Interface Guidelines from Vercel Labs' separate guideline source before every review. The installed Skill is the workflow; the current rules are fetched at review time.
body.zh: SKILL.md 要求 Agent 每次审查前，从 Vercel Labs 独立的网页界面规范来源获取最新规则。安装的 Skill 是工作流程，具体规则在审查时读取。

title.en: Is this an accessibility certification?
title.zh: 它能提供无障碍合规认证吗？

body.en: No. File-level findings can uncover implementation problems, but rendered behavior, assistive technology, device interactions, and applicable standards need separate testing.
body.zh: 不能。文件级检查能发现实现问题，但渲染行为、辅助技术、设备交互及适用标准仍需另行测试。

prompt.en: Review the checkout form components against current web interface guidelines. Report only actionable file:line findings.
prompt.zh: 按最新网页界面规范审查结账表单组件，只报告可执行的 file:line 问题。

result.en: A useful response points to the exact control and line, explains the interaction problem, and avoids unlocated aesthetic opinions.
result.zh: 合格结果应指出具体控件与行号，解释交互问题，避免无法定位的审美评论。

title.en: Select files
title.zh: 确定文件

body.en: Name the page or component files; the original workflow asks for a path if none is provided.
body.zh: 指定页面或组件文件；原始流程在没有路径时会先询问。

title.en: Fetch current rules
title.zh: 获取当前规则

body.en: Read the live guideline source rather than relying on a cached checklist.
body.zh: 读取实时规范来源，而不是依赖旧检查清单。

title.en: Verify located findings
title.zh: 核对定位结果

body.en: Check reported file:line issues against the rendered interface before editing.
body.zh: 修改前，把报告中的 file:line 问题与实际界面对应起来。

en: A review scoped to named source files
Issues to verify in the rendered page
zh: 按文件和行号定位的 UI 问题
针对指定源码的审查
待在实际页面验证的问题

en: Was the latest guideline source fetched?
Are the findings tied to the requested files?
Does the live UI reproduce the issue?
zh: 是否获取了最新规范来源？
问题是否对应指定文件？
实际页面能否复现问题？

question.en: Does the Skill contain all web design rules?
question.zh: 这个 Skill 内置了全部网页设计规则吗？

answer.en: No. Its SKILL.md points to a separate, freshly fetched Web Interface Guidelines source.
answer.zh: 没有。SKILL.md 指向另一个网页界面规范来源，并要求每次审查时重新获取。

question.en: Can it review a website URL alone?
question.zh: 只给网址就能审查吗？

answer.en: Its documented workflow reads specified source files. For visual or browser behavior, add a separate rendered-page review.
answer.zh: 原始流程针对指定源码文件。要检查视觉或浏览器行为，还需要另做页面渲染审查。

question.en: What does the result look like?
question.zh: 结果是什么形式？

answer.en: The source asks for terse findings tied to file and line locations, making them easier to verify and fix.
answer.zh: 原文要求用简洁的文件与行号定位问题，便于核对和修复。

question.en: Does a clean review guarantee accessibility?
question.zh: 没有报错就代表无障碍合格吗？

answer.en: No. Assistive-technology and real interaction tests are still needed; file review is one layer.
answer.zh: 不代表。仍需辅助技术和真实交互测试；文件审查只是其中一层。

title.en: Vercel Writing Guidelines Skill for Docs Reviews
title.zh: Vercel Writing Guidelines：文档与技术写作审查 Skill

description.en: Learn how the Writing Guidelines Skill checks docs and prose against Vercel's current writing handbook, with located findings.
description.zh: 了解 Writing Guidelines Skill 如何依据 Vercel 最新写作手册检查文档与文案，并输出可定位的问题。

zh: Vercel Writing Guidelines
文档审查 Skill
技术写作规范 Skill

title.en: Writing Guidelines: review the docs you actually ship
title.zh: Writing Guidelines：审查真正要发布的文档

description.en: A writing-review Skill that fetches Vercel's current handbook, reads the files you specify, and reports concrete prose or structure issues.
description.zh: 这个写作审查 Skill 会获取 Vercel 当前的写作手册，阅读指定文件，并指出具体的语言和结构问题。

summary.en: The Skill is not a general-purpose copy generator. Its documented workflow retrieves the latest writing guidelines and checks named docs or prose files, with terse file-and-line findings.
summary.zh: 它不是通用文案生成器。原始流程要求获取最新写作规范，检查指定文档或文案文件，并用简洁的文件与行号呈现发现。

installNote.en: Installs upstream instructions. Reviews also require fetching the publisher's current writing handbook.
installNote.zh: 安装的是上游指令；审查时还需要获取发布方当前的写作手册。

guideTitle.en: Review words in their document context
guideTitle.zh: 结合文档类型审查文字

guideIntro.en: A tutorial, reference page, and troubleshooting guide make different promises. Identify the content type before applying a rule.
guideIntro.zh: 教程、参考页和故障排查文档承担不同任务；应用规则前先确定内容类型。

ctaTitle.en: Work through the draft and review notes together
ctaTitle.zh: 让草稿与审查意见在同一处推进

ctaDescription.en: Bring the target document and revision decisions into Floatboat, while keeping Vercel's handbook as the attributed source.
ctaDescription.zh: 把目标文档和修改决定放在 Floatboat 中推进，同时保留 Vercel 写作手册的来源归属。

useCases.en: What the writing review is for
useCases.zh: 这个写作审查适合什么

useCasesDescription.en: Use it for concrete docs or prose files that need a standards-based pass.
useCasesDescription.zh: 用它检查需要按规范复核的具体文档或文案文件。

howDescription.en: The Skill reads current guidelines and named files, then returns specific findings rather than rewriting without context.
howDescription.zh: 先读当前规范和指定文件，再反馈具体问题，而不是脱离上下文地重写。

title.en: A tutorial is hard to follow
title.zh: 教程读起来不顺

body.en: Check whether headings, steps, examples, and prerequisites follow the user's task rather than the author's implementation notes.
body.zh: 检查标题、步骤、示例和前提条件是否围绕读者任务，而不是作者的实现笔记。

title.en: An API reference hides key conditions
title.zh: API 参考页埋没了使用条件

body.en: Review names, parameter descriptions, code formatting, and the placement of limits or caveats.
body.zh: 检查名称、参数说明、代码格式，以及限制和注意事项的位置。

title.en: A release note sounds vague
title.zh: 更新说明过于空泛

body.en: Look for unsupported adjectives, missing user impact, and phrases that obscure the actual change.
body.zh: 找出缺乏依据的形容词、缺失的用户影响，以及掩盖实际变更的表述。

notFor.en: Fact-checking product behavior that is absent from the provided source.
notFor.zh: 核查未提供来源的产品行为事实。

notFor.en: Replacing a company's own editorial policy with Vercel's house style without approval.
notFor.zh: 未经确认就用 Vercel 的品牌文风替代团队自身的编辑规范。

title.en: Does the Skill write new documentation?
title.zh: 这个 Skill 会写新文档吗？

body.en: Its documented purpose is review: fetch the latest handbook, inspect named files, and report located issues. An agent may help revise a draft afterward, but that is a separate instruction and editorial decision.
body.zh: 原始用途是审查：获取最新手册、检查指定文件、报告定位问题。之后可让 Agent 协助修改，但那属于另一个指令和编辑决定。

title.en: Should another team adopt Vercel's style rules unchanged?
title.zh: 其他团队要原样采用 Vercel 文风吗？

body.en: Not necessarily. The rules are Vercel's publisher-specific writing handbook. Compare findings with your own voice, localization needs, and documentation contract before accepting an edit.
body.zh: 不一定。这些是 Vercel 的发布方专属写作规则。接受修改前，应与自己的品牌语气、本地化需求及文档契约比较。

prompt.en: Review these onboarding docs against the current Vercel writing guidelines. Give file:line findings; do not rewrite factual claims.
prompt.zh: 按当前 Vercel 写作规范审查这些入门文档，给出 file:line 问题，不要改写事实陈述。

result.en: A useful review distinguishes unclear instructions from house-style preferences and points to each affected line.
result.zh: 合格审查会区分不清楚的操作说明与品牌文风偏好，并标出受影响行。

title.en: Name the documents
title.zh: 指定文档

body.en: Provide files or a pattern and state whether they are tutorials, references, or another content type.
body.zh: 提供文件或路径模式，并说明内容属于教程、参考文档或其他类型。

title.en: Fetch the current handbook
title.zh: 获取最新手册

body.en: The source instructs a fresh fetch before every review.
body.zh: 原始指令要求每次审查前重新获取写作手册。

title.en: Accept edits deliberately
title.zh: 有选择地接受修改

body.en: Review located findings against factual accuracy and your own editorial voice.
body.zh: 将定位问题与事实准确性、团队文风逐一对照。

en: Structure and clarity issues tied to the document
A shortlist of edits to accept or reject
zh: 按文件和行号定位的文字问题
与目标文档相关的结构和清晰度问题
待接受或驳回的修改短名单

en: Does the finding preserve the document's facts?
Is Vercel's house style appropriate for this publisher?
zh: 是否获取了当前规范？
修改是否保留文档事实？
Vercel 的品牌文风是否适合当前发布者？

question.en: Is Writing Guidelines a writing generator?
question.zh: Writing Guidelines 是写作生成器吗？

answer.en: No. The documented workflow reviews existing docs or prose and reports issues. Generating new content would need a separate task.
answer.zh: 不是。原始流程审查已有文档或文案并反馈问题；生成新内容需要另行提出任务。

question.en: Where are the rules stored?
question.zh: 规则保存在哪里？

answer.en: The installed SKILL.md points to the separate Vercel writing-handbook source and asks the agent to fetch it fresh for each review.
answer.zh: 安装的 SKILL.md 指向独立的 Vercel 写作手册来源，并要求 Agent 每次审查时重新获取。

question.en: Can I apply it to non-Vercel docs?
question.zh: 非 Vercel 文档可以用吗？

answer.en: You can use it as a review lens, but its style preferences belong to Vercel. Keep your own brand and documentation requirements authoritative.
answer.zh: 可以作为审查视角，但其文风偏好属于 Vercel。你的品牌和文档要求仍应优先。

question.en: What input does it need?
question.zh: 使用时需要提供什么？

answer.en: Provide a file or pattern to review. The original workflow asks for target files if none are specified.
answer.zh: 需要提供待审查文件或路径模式；如果没有指定，原始流程会先询问。

title.en: Deploy to Vercel Skill: Preview Deployment Workflow
title.zh: Deploy to Vercel Skill：预览部署工作流程

description.en: Understand how the Deploy to Vercel Skill checks project linkage, team scope, and deployment path before creating a preview.
description.zh: 了解 Deploy to Vercel Skill 如何检查项目关联、团队范围与部署路径，再创建预览部署。

zh: Deploy to Vercel Skill
Vercel 预览部署 Skill
Vercel 部署工作流

title.en: Deploy to Vercel: know what will go live, and where
title.zh: Deploy to Vercel：先弄清部署到哪里、影响什么

description.en: A deployment Skill that checks repository and Vercel project state, chooses an appropriate path, and defaults to a preview unless production is explicitly requested.
description.zh: 部署型 Skill：先检查仓库与 Vercel 项目状态，再选择部署方式；除非明确要求生产环境，否则以预览部署为默认。

summary.en: The original workflow starts with read-only checks for Git remote, project linkage, CLI authentication, and teams. It then selects a deployment route. A linked Git project may use a push, but the source requires asking before pushing.
summary.zh: 原始流程先只读检查 Git 远端、项目关联、CLI 登录和团队，再决定部署路径。已关联 Git 的项目可能通过推送部署，但原文要求推送前征得用户同意。

installNote.en: This installs agent instructions, not a Vercel account or a Floatboat deployment integration.
installNote.zh: 这只安装 Agent 指令，不会创建 Vercel 账户或 Floatboat 部署集成。

guideTitle.en: Preview first, with the right project and team
guideTitle.zh: 先预览，并确认项目和团队

guideIntro.en: Deployment can change external state. The workflow checks linkage and scope before using Git or CLI, and distinguishes preview from production.
guideIntro.zh: 部署会改变外部状态。该流程先核对项目关联与团队范围，再使用 Git 或 CLI，并区分预览与生产环境。

ctaTitle.en: Keep release decisions beside the work
ctaTitle.zh: 让发布决定与实际工作保持同步

ctaDescription.en: Use Floatboat to review the change, intended environment, and approval trail before invoking an external deployment workflow.
ctaDescription.zh: 在启动外部部署流程前，用 Floatboat 复核改动、目标环境和批准记录。

useCases.en: When this deployment Skill is useful
useCases.zh: 什么时候使用这个部署 Skill

useCasesDescription.en: Use it when the requested result is a Vercel preview or release, not merely a build check.
useCasesDescription.zh: 当目标是 Vercel 预览或正式发布，而不只是检查构建时使用。

exclusions.en: Deployment decisions that still need you
exclusions.zh: 仍须由你决定的部署问题

how.en: How it chooses a deployment path

howDescription.en: The source begins with project-state checks, then uses the available linked Git or CLI path.
howDescription.zh: 原文先检查项目状态，再按已关联的 Git 或可用的 CLI 路径执行。

title.en: Share a reviewable build
title.zh: 生成可供审阅的版本

body.en: Ask for a preview URL so a teammate can inspect the change without targeting production.
body.zh: 请求预览地址，让同事检查改动，不直接触碰生产环境。

title.en: The local folder may point to the wrong project
title.zh: 本地目录可能关联错项目

body.en: Check existing Vercel link files and Git remote before running any command that might silently connect a project.
body.zh: 在运行可能悄悄关联项目的命令前，先核对 Vercel 关联文件与 Git 远端。

title.en: Several Vercel teams are available
title.zh: 存在多个 Vercel 团队

body.en: Confirm the intended team or use the linked project's org ID instead of guessing an account scope.
body.zh: 确认目标团队，或使用已关联项目的组织 ID，不靠猜测选择账户。

notFor.en: Implicit permission to push commits or deploy production; approval and environment choice still matter.
notFor.zh: 默认获得推送提交或部署生产环境的权限；批准和环境选择仍然重要。

notFor.en: A generic CI/CD guide for providers other than Vercel.
notFor.zh: 面向其他云厂商的通用 CI/CD 指南。

title.en: Does Deploy to Vercel publish to production by default?
title.zh: Deploy to Vercel 默认会发布到生产环境吗？

body.en: No. The source says to deploy a preview unless the user explicitly asks for production. It also requires checking the current project and team before choosing a method.
body.zh: 不会。原文要求除非用户明确提出生产部署，否则默认创建预览。同时要先核对当前项目与团队，再选择部署方式。

title.en: Will it push code without asking?
title.zh: 它会不询问就推送代码吗？

body.en: The documented Git-push path requires the agent to ask before pushing. A Skill is guidance to the host agent, not a separate source of permission to change your repository.
body.zh: 原文规定，走 Git 推送路径时 Agent 必须先询问。Skill 是给宿主 Agent 的指导，不会单独赋予修改仓库的权限。

prompt.en: Create a Vercel preview for this branch, confirm the linked project and team first, and do not push or deploy production without asking me.
prompt.zh: 为这个分支创建 Vercel 预览，先确认关联的项目和团队；未询问前不要推送或部署生产环境。

result.en: A useful response reports the detected project state, selected preview path, any required approval, and the resulting URL when deployment succeeds.
result.zh: 合格结果应说明检测到的项目状态、选择的预览路径、所需批准，以及部署成功后的地址。

title.en: Check local state
title.zh: 检查本地状态

body.en: Read the Git remote, Vercel link files, CLI authentication, and team list.
body.zh: 读取 Git 远端、Vercel 关联文件、CLI 登录状态及团队列表。

title.en: Select preview route
title.zh: 确定预览路径

body.en: Use the linked workflow that matches the project; ask before any Git push.
body.zh: 选用与项目关联状态匹配的流程；任何 Git 推送前先询问。

title.en: Return and inspect URL
title.zh: 返回并检查地址

body.en: Confirm that the preview belongs to the intended project and actually loads.
body.zh: 确认预览属于目标项目，并且页面确实可访问。

en: A reviewable deployment URL when successful
zh: 确认过的项目与团队范围
预览部署路径
成功时可供审阅的部署地址

en: Is the target preview or production?
Was the Git push explicitly approved?
Does the deployment belong to the correct project?
zh: 目标是预览还是生产？
Git 推送是否获得明确批准？
部署是否属于正确项目？

question.en: What does this Skill install?
question.zh: 安装这个 Skill 会安装什么？

answer.en: It adds agent instructions. You still need appropriate Vercel access and a project that can be built and deployed.
answer.zh: 它添加 Agent 指令。执行部署仍需适当的 Vercel 权限与可构建的项目。

question.en: Is preview deployment the default?
question.zh: 默认是预览部署吗？

answer.en: Yes. The source reserves production for an explicit user request.
answer.zh: 是。原文只在用户明确提出时才走生产部署。

question.en: Does it choose a Vercel team automatically?
question.zh: 它会自动选择 Vercel 团队吗？

answer.en: A linked project can establish the team. If multiple unlinked teams are possible, the workflow asks which one is intended.
answer.zh: 已关联项目可以确定团队；若未关联且有多个可用团队，流程会询问目标团队。

question.en: How is this different from Vercel CLI with Tokens?
question.zh: 它与 Vercel CLI with Tokens 有何不同？

answer.en: Deploy to Vercel is the general deployment-decision workflow. Vercel CLI with Tokens focuses on authenticated CLI operations using an existing access token.
answer.zh: Deploy to Vercel 处理一般的部署决策；Vercel CLI with Tokens 聚焦使用已有访问令牌执行 CLI 操作。

title.en: Vercel CLI with Tokens Skill: Authenticated Agent Workflow
title.zh: Vercel CLI with Tokens Skill：令牌认证工作流

description.en: See when the Vercel CLI with Tokens Skill applies, how it identifies project scope, and how to avoid exposing access tokens.
description.zh: 了解 Vercel CLI with Tokens Skill 适用场景、项目范围确认方式与令牌保密要求。

zh: Vercel CLI with Tokens
Vercel 令牌部署 Skill
Vercel CLI 认证

title.en: Vercel CLI with Tokens: scope the account before the command
title.zh: Vercel CLI with Tokens：运行命令前先确认账户范围

description.en: A Skill for Vercel CLI work when an access token, rather than interactive login, is the authentication path. It emphasizes token handling and project/team targeting.
description.zh: 当 Vercel CLI 使用访问令牌而不是交互登录时，这个 Skill 指导令牌处理，以及项目与团队的准确定位。

summary.en: The source first checks where the token and project identifiers come from. It warns against placing tokens in command-line arguments and distinguishes authentication from knowing which project and organization a command will affect.
summary.zh: 原始流程先确认令牌和项目标识的来源，明确警告不要把令牌写在命令行参数中，并区分“已认证”和“知道命令会影响哪个项目及组织”。

kind.zh: 已认证 CLI 工作流 Skill

installNote.en: Installs instructions only. A Vercel token and correctly scoped project access are separate prerequisites.
installNote.zh: 只安装指令；Vercel 令牌与准确的项目权限是另外的前提。

guideTitle.zh: 认证成功不等于项目选择正确

guideIntro.en: A valid token can access several projects or teams. Confirm the target before any command that changes Vercel state.
guideIntro.zh: 一个有效令牌可能访问多个项目或团队；执行任何会改变 Vercel 状态的命令前，都要确认目标。

ctaTitle.en: Review the target before running deployment commands
ctaTitle.zh: 运行部署命令前，先复核目标

ctaDescription.en: Use Floatboat to keep the task and target-project decision explicit. Handle secret tokens only through your approved environment.
ctaDescription.zh: 用 Floatboat 明确记录任务与目标项目决定；敏感令牌只应通过已批准的环境管理。

useCases.zh: 何时需要令牌式 CLI 指导

useCasesDescription.en: Use it when a Vercel access token is the approved authentication mechanism for deployment or management.
useCasesDescription.zh: 当团队批准使用 Vercel 访问令牌进行部署或管理时使用。

exclusions.en: What the Skill will not provide
exclusions.zh: 这个 Skill 不会提供什么

how.en: How it scopes a token-based operation
how.zh: 如何定位令牌操作的范围

howDescription.en: Locate auth, identify project and organization, then execute a bounded Vercel CLI task.
howDescription.zh: 先定位认证信息，再识别项目和组织，最后执行有边界的 CLI 任务。

title.en: A non-interactive environment needs Vercel access
title.zh: 非交互环境需要 Vercel 权限

body.en: Use an existing secret-managed token without relying on an interactive vercel login session.
body.zh: 使用由密钥管理系统保存的既有令牌，不依赖交互式 vercel login。

title.en: One token can reach multiple projects
title.zh: 一个令牌可访问多个项目

body.en: Confirm project and organization identifiers before changing environment variables or deploying.
body.zh: 修改环境变量或部署前，确认项目与组织标识。

title.en: A command could expose a secret
title.zh: 命令可能泄露密钥

body.en: Keep tokens out of pasted commands, logs, and review comments; use the approved environment mechanism.
body.zh: 不要把令牌粘进命令、日志或审查评论；使用已批准的环境管理方式。

notFor.en: Obtaining a token or permission you do not already have.
notFor.zh: 获取尚未拥有的令牌或权限。

notFor.en: Treating any authenticated account as the correct deployment target.
notFor.zh: 把任意已登录账户当成正确的部署目标。

title.en: Why avoid passing a Vercel token on the command line?
title.zh: 为什么不要在命令行中传 Vercel 令牌？

body.en: The source warns that command arguments can appear in shell history and process listings. Its workflow uses the CLI's environment-based token handling and requires care with outputs and logs.
body.zh: 原文提醒命令参数可能出现在 Shell 历史和进程列表中，因此流程使用 CLI 的环境变量认证，同时要谨慎处理输出与日志。

title.en: How does this differ from Deploy to Vercel?
title.zh: 它与 Deploy to Vercel 的侧重点有何不同？

body.en: Deploy to Vercel begins with selecting an overall deployment path and preview environment. This Skill is narrower: operating Vercel CLI securely when token-based authentication is already the chosen path.
body.zh: Deploy to Vercel 先决定整体部署方式与预览环境；这个 Skill 更窄，专门处理已选择令牌认证时如何安全操作 Vercel CLI。

prompt.en: Use the approved Vercel token to inspect this project's environment settings. Confirm project and team IDs first; never print the token.
prompt.zh: 使用已批准的 Vercel 令牌检查这个项目的环境设置，先核对项目和团队 ID，绝不要输出令牌。

result.en: A useful answer reports the confirmed target and requested settings while redacting secrets and avoiding unrelated account changes.
result.zh: 合格结果应确认目标、反馈所请求的设置，并隐藏密钥、不改动无关账户。

title.en: Identify the approved token source
title.zh: 确认已批准的令牌来源

body.en: Use the environment or secret store without revealing the token value in chat or commands.
body.zh: 通过环境或密钥管理系统使用令牌，不在聊天或命令中暴露其值。

title.en: Resolve project and team
title.zh: 确定项目与团队

body.en: Verify IDs or linked configuration instead of assuming the current CLI context.
body.zh: 核对标识或已关联配置，不想当然地使用当前 CLI 上下文。

title.en: Run the authorized operation
title.zh: 执行已授权操作

body.en: Limit commands to the requested project and keep secret-bearing output out of reports.
body.zh: 把命令限制在目标项目，报告中不包含敏感输出。

en: A confirmed Vercel project and organization
zh: 确认过的 Vercel 项目与组织
范围明确的 CLI 操作
不包含密钥的执行报告

en: Do project and team identifiers match the request?
Could command or log output reveal a secret?
zh: 令牌来源是否已获批准？
项目与团队标识是否符合请求？
命令或日志输出是否可能泄露密钥？

question.en: Does the Skill give me a Vercel token?
question.zh: 这个 Skill 会提供 Vercel 令牌吗？

answer.en: No. It guides use of an existing, authorized token. Creating or granting access is separate account work.
answer.zh: 不会。它指导使用已有且获授权的令牌；创建令牌或授予权限属于另一个账户操作。

question.en: Can I paste a token into the prompt?
question.zh: 可以把令牌粘贴到提示词里吗？

answer.en: Avoid it. Use your approved secret-management environment and keep token values out of chat, commands, and reports.
answer.zh: 应避免。通过获批准的密钥管理环境使用，并让令牌值远离聊天、命令和报告。

question.en: Why check both project and organization?
question.zh: 为什么项目与组织都要确认？

answer.en: A valid token may cover multiple scopes. Authentication alone does not prove that a CLI command points to the intended project.
answer.zh: 有效令牌可能覆盖多个范围；认证成功不能证明命令指向了目标项目。

question.en: Is interactive login required?
question.zh: 必须交互登录吗？

answer.en: No. The Skill is specifically for token-based CLI work instead of depending on an interactive vercel login session.
answer.zh: 不必。这个 Skill 专门用于令牌式 CLI 操作，不依赖交互式 vercel login。

title.en: Vercel Optimize Skill for Cost and Performance Audits
title.zh: Vercel Optimize Skill：成本与性能审查

description.en: Explore Vercel Optimize's metrics-first workflow for investigating costly routes, function usage, caching, and performance with verified evidence.
description.zh: 了解 Vercel Optimize 如何先看指标，再调查高成本路由、函数使用、缓存和性能问题。

zh: Vercel Optimize Skill
Vercel 成本优化
Vercel 性能审查

eyebrow.zh: Vercel Labs · 指标优先审查

title.en: Vercel Optimize: investigate what the metrics point to
title.zh: Vercel Optimize：让指标决定先查哪里

description.en: A Vercel cost and performance Skill that collects production signals before reading code, then narrows investigation to routes and files backed by evidence.
description.zh: 面向 Vercel 成本与性能的 Skill：先收集生产指标，再把代码调查范围缩到有证据指向的路由与文件。

summary.en: The source prescribes an observability-first audit, not a repository-wide optimization sweep. Its scripts collect and merge Vercel signals, gate investigations, and produce ranked recommendations; route-level advice depends on access and observability prerequisites.
summary.zh: 原始流程强调可观测性优先，而非全仓库随意扫一遍。它用脚本汇总 Vercel 信号、筛选调查对象并排序建议；路由级结论依赖相应权限和可观测性前提。

kind.zh: 带脚本的指标驱动审查 Skill

installNote.en: Installs upstream instructions and bundled resources; Vercel CLI access and Observability Plus may still be required.
installNote.zh: 安装上游指令及附带资源；仍可能需要 Vercel CLI 权限和 Observability Plus。

guideIntro.en: Its gate narrows work to measurable candidates. A missing metric or ambiguous project scope is a limitation to report, not a cue to invent savings.
guideIntro.zh: 筛选流程只处理有数据支持的候选项。缺少指标或项目范围不明确时，应报告限制，不能凭空估算收益。

ctaTitle.en: Turn verified bottlenecks into bounded tasks
ctaTitle.zh: 把已验证的瓶颈拆成有边界的任务

ctaDescription.en: Bring the metric, affected route, and proposed change into Floatboat; keep the original Vercel audit source and access requirements visible.
ctaDescription.zh: 在 Floatboat 中并排整理指标、受影响路由与修改建议，同时保留原始审查来源和访问要求。

useCases.zh: 何时适合使用 Vercel Optimize

useCasesDescription.en: Use it for a deployed Vercel project with a specific cost or performance question and accessible production signals.
useCasesDescription.zh: 当 Vercel 已部署项目有明确的成本或性能问题，而且能访问生产指标时使用。

exclusions.zh: 哪些情况缺少必要证据

how.zh: 指标优先审查如何进行

howDescription.en: Project scope and signals come first; code reading follows only candidates selected by the gate.
howDescription.zh: 先确认项目范围并收集信号，只有筛选出的候选项才进入代码调查。

title.en: Function usage rose unexpectedly
title.zh: 函数使用量突然上升

body.en: Check usage and route metrics before attributing the bill change to a particular endpoint or cache setting.
body.zh: 先看使用量和路由指标，再判断账单变化是否与某个端点或缓存设置有关。

title.en: One page seems expensive or slow
title.zh: 某个页面似乎既慢又贵

body.en: Let measured route signals identify which source files and settings deserve investigation.
body.zh: 由可测量的路由信号决定哪些源码文件和设置值得调查。

title.en: A cache change is being proposed
title.zh: 有人建议修改缓存

body.en: Confirm the current hit pattern and framework behavior before recommending ISR, middleware, or response-cache changes.
body.zh: 在建议 ISR、中间件或响应缓存改动前，先确认当前命中模式和框架行为。

notFor.en: A precise savings claim when metrics, usage, or project scope cannot be verified.
notFor.zh: 在指标、使用量或项目范围无法核实时给出精确节省金额。

notFor.en: An unrestricted code sweep of an unlinked or unsupported project.
notFor.zh: 对未关联或不支持的项目做无边界全仓代码扫描。

title.en: Why does Vercel Optimize start with metrics?
title.zh: Vercel Optimize 为什么先看指标？

body.en: The source explicitly delays source-code inspection until collected signals and a deterministic gate point to a candidate. That helps distinguish high-cost routes from merely suspicious code patterns.
body.zh: 原文明确要求先收集信号并通过确定性筛选，再阅读被指标指向的源码。这样可以区分真正高成本的路由和只是看起来可疑的代码。

title.en: What access is needed for route-level recommendations?
title.zh: 获得路由级建议需要什么权限？

body.en: The source lists a linked Vercel project, supported CLI and Node versions, correct account scope, and Observability Plus for route-level metric-backed advice. Without those, the audit must state the limitation.
body.zh: 原文列出项目关联、受支持的 CLI 与 Node 版本、正确账户范围；路由级指标建议还需要 Observability Plus。缺少这些条件时，审查必须说明限制。

prompt.en: Investigate last month's Vercel function-cost increase. Confirm the project scope, use available metrics, and rank only evidence-backed opportunities.
prompt.zh: 调查上个月 Vercel 函数成本上涨。先确认项目范围，读取可用指标，只排序有证据支持的优化机会。

result.en: A useful audit names measured routes, supporting signals, bounded code locations, prerequisites, and uncertainty; it does not invent a savings figure.
result.zh: 合格审查应指出测量过的路由、支撑指标、有限的代码位置、前提和不确定性，不编造节省金额。

title.en: Resolve project scope
title.zh: 确认项目范围

body.en: Identify the linked project and owner before collecting metrics or usage.
body.zh: 读取指标或用量前，先确认关联项目和所属账户。

title.en: Collect and gate signals
title.zh: 收集并筛选信号

body.en: Use the bundled collection and gate workflow to select measurable candidates.
body.zh: 用附带的收集和筛选流程挑选有指标支撑的候选项。

title.en: Inspect and rank
title.zh: 调查并排序

body.en: Read only the candidate's route-local files, then present verified, version-aware recommendations.
body.zh: 只阅读候选路由相关文件，再给出经过核实且匹配版本的建议。

zh: 有指标支撑的候选列表
按优先级排序的成本或性能建议
明确的阻碍与数据限制

en: Is the Vercel project and owner unambiguous?
Are route metrics available for the desired claim?
Does the framework fall within supported scope?
zh: Vercel 项目与所属账户是否明确？
所需结论有路由指标支持吗？
框架是否在支持范围内？

question.en: Does Vercel Optimize scan the entire repository first?
question.zh: Vercel Optimize 会先扫描整个仓库吗？

answer.en: No. Its documented doctrine collects production signals first and gates code investigation to metric-backed candidates.
answer.zh: 不会。原始原则先收集生产信号，再把代码调查限定在有指标支持的候选项。

question.en: Can it estimate savings without Observability Plus?
question.zh: 没有 Observability Plus 能估算节省金额吗？

answer.en: Route-level metric-backed recommendations require the stated observability access. Missing data should be reported as a limitation, not replaced with invented precision.
answer.zh: 路由级指标建议依赖原文要求的可观测性权限。缺少数据应明确说明，不能用虚构的精确数字代替。

question.en: Which frameworks does it address?
question.zh: 它适用于哪些框架？

answer.en: The source lists strong support for Next.js, support for SvelteKit and Nuxt, limited Astro support, and a restricted path for others. Check the current source before running an audit.
answer.zh: 原文对 Next.js 支持最完整，也支持 SvelteKit、Nuxt；Astro 有限，其他框架需要受限流程。运行前应核对当前来源。

question.en: Is it only a prose checklist?
question.zh: 它只是文字检查清单吗？

answer.en: No. The Skill bundles scripts and references for signal collection, gating, and report generation. Those still depend on authorized Vercel access.
answer.zh: 不是。它带有信号收集、筛选和报告所需的脚本及参考资料，但仍依赖已授权的 Vercel 访问。

title.zh: agent-browser Skill：通向浏览器 CLI 的指令入口

description.en: This Skill is a small discovery stub. It tells an agent to load version-matched browser workflows from the installed agent-browser CLI; the CLI performs the actual actions.
description.zh: 这个 Skill 是精简的引导入口，告诉 Agent 从已安装的 agent-browser CLI 加载与版本匹配的流程；真正的浏览器操作由 CLI 执行。

summary.en: The repository's primary product is the agent-browser CLI, not this SKILL.md. The Skill points the agent to `agent-browser skills get core` and specialized workflows, keeping detailed instructions aligned with the installed tool version.
summary.zh: 该仓库的主体是 agent-browser CLI，而不是这份 SKILL.md。Skill 指向 `agent-browser skills get core` 及专门流程，让详细指令与已安装的工具版本保持一致。

kind.zh: 配套 Skill / 发现入口

installNote.en: This adds the Skill stub only. Browser automation requires a separate agent-browser CLI installation and browser setup.
installNote.zh: 这只添加 Skill 入口；浏览器自动化仍需另外安装 agent-browser CLI 并完成浏览器设置。

guideTitle.en: The Skill routes; the CLI acts
guideTitle.zh: Skill 负责指路，CLI 负责操作

guideIntro.en: Treat the short SKILL.md as an entry point. The installed CLI serves current core and specialist workflows before commands are run.
guideIntro.zh: 简短的 SKILL.md 只是入口。运行命令前，应从已安装 CLI 读取当前核心或专项流程。

ctaTitle.zh: 让浏览器观察结果回到原任务

ctaDescription.en: Use Floatboat to collect the goal, observations, and review decisions; browser execution still depends on the separate upstream CLI.
ctaDescription.zh: 用 Floatboat 整理目标、观察结果与审阅决定；浏览器执行仍依赖独立的上游 CLI。

useCases.zh: 什么时候需要这个配套 Skill

useCasesDescription.en: Use it when an agent already has the CLI available and needs the matching workflow for a browser task.
useCasesDescription.zh: 当 Agent 已能使用 CLI，又需要与工具版本匹配的浏览器流程时使用。

exclusions.en: What the stub cannot do alone
exclusions.zh: 单靠这个入口做不到什么

how.zh: 如何加载浏览器操作指引

howDescription.en: Install the Skill and CLI separately, then load the CLI's current core or specialized instructions.
howDescription.zh: 分别安装 Skill 和 CLI，再读取 CLI 当前的核心或专项指令。

title.en: An agent must inspect a live flow
title.zh: Agent 需要检查真实网页流程

body.en: Load the CLI's core workflow before navigating, snapshotting controls, or testing a form.
body.zh: 导航、读取控件快照或测试表单前，先加载 CLI 核心流程。

title.en: A bug needs exploratory reproduction
title.zh: Bug 需要探索式复现

body.en: The stub points to a specialist dogfood workflow for exploratory testing and quality review.
body.zh: 入口文件会指向专门的 dogfood 流程，用于探索式测试和质量检查。

title.en: The target is an Electron app
title.zh: 目标是 Electron 应用

body.en: Use the CLI's dedicated Electron guidance instead of assuming a normal web-page session.
body.zh: 应使用 CLI 的 Electron 专项指引，而不是把它当普通网页会话。

notFor.en: Browser automation without the separate agent-browser CLI and browser setup.
notFor.zh: 没有独立安装 agent-browser CLI 和浏览器环境就执行自动化。

notFor.en: Treating this short SKILL.md as the complete command reference.
notFor.zh: 把这份简短 SKILL.md 当作完整命令手册。

title.en: Is agent-browser a Skill or a tool?
title.zh: agent-browser 是 Skill 还是工具？

body.en: The repository's main deliverable is a browser-automation CLI. It also publishes a companion SKILL.md that tells agents how to discover version-matched workflows. This page describes that Skill entry, not the CLI as a standalone product.
body.zh: 仓库的主要交付物是浏览器自动化 CLI，同时发布一份配套 SKILL.md，指导 Agent 找到与版本匹配的流程。本页介绍的是这个 Skill 入口，不是把 CLI 当成单独的 Skill。

title.en: Why is the SKILL.md intentionally short?
title.zh: 为什么 SKILL.md 特意写得很短？

body.en: The source calls it a discovery stub. Detailed workflows are served by the installed CLI through `skills get core` or a specialist name, so instructions track the tool version instead of becoming stale copies.
body.zh: 原文称其为发现入口。详细流程由已安装 CLI 通过 `skills get core` 或专项名称提供，从而随工具版本更新，避免复制品过时。

prompt.en: Use agent-browser to test the sign-in flow. Load the current core instructions first, then report the exact step that fails.
prompt.zh: 用 agent-browser 测试登录流程。先加载当前核心指引，再报告具体在哪一步失败。

result.en: A useful result separates guidance loading from CLI execution and reports observed browser behavior, not an assumed pass.
result.zh: 合格结果会区分指引加载与 CLI 执行，并报告观察到的浏览器行为，而不是假定测试通过。

note.en: The Skill stub alone cannot run browser commands.
note.zh: 只有 Skill 入口无法运行浏览器命令。

note.en: Follow the CLI's upstream installation instructions.
note.zh: 按照上游 CLI 安装说明操作。

note.en: The CLI serves instructions matched to its installed version.
note.zh: CLI 会提供与已安装版本匹配的指令。

title.zh: 安装配套 Skill

body.en: Add the published SKILL.md to a supported agent through the upstream Skills CLI.
body.zh: 通过上游 Skills CLI，把发布的 SKILL.md 加入受支持的 Agent。

title.en: Prepare the CLI
title.zh: 准备 CLI

body.en: Install agent-browser and its browser dependency through the upstream tool instructions.
body.zh: 按上游工具说明安装 agent-browser 及其浏览器依赖。

title.en: Load the matching workflow
title.zh: 加载匹配的流程

body.en: Get core or specialist guidance from the CLI before interacting with the target.
body.zh: 与目标交互前，先从 CLI 获取核心或专项指引。

en: A clear split between Skill guidance and tool execution
zh: 与版本匹配的浏览器流程
由 CLI 交互得到的实际观察
Skill 指引与工具执行的明确边界

en: Did the agent load `skills get core`?
zh: CLI 是否确实已安装？
Agent 是否读取了 `skills get core`？
请求的交互是否已获授权？

question.en: Does installing the Skill install the browser CLI?
question.zh: 安装 Skill 会同时安装浏览器 CLI 吗？

answer.en: No. The Skill adds a short instruction stub. The agent-browser CLI and browser setup are separate installations.
answer.zh: 不会。Skill 只添加精简指令入口；agent-browser CLI 和浏览器环境需要单独安装。

question.en: Where are the full browser instructions?
question.zh: 完整浏览器指令在哪里？

answer.en: The installed CLI serves them through `agent-browser skills get core` and specialist workflows such as `dogfood` or `electron`.
answer.zh: 已安装 CLI 通过 `agent-browser skills get core` 以及 `dogfood`、`electron` 等专项流程提供。

question.en: Why does the repository look like a tool?
question.zh: 为什么这个仓库看起来像工具？

answer.en: Because it is primarily a CLI tool. The SKILL.md is a companion component for AI agents; the two should not be classified as the same deliverable.
answer.zh: 因为它的主体确实是 CLI 工具；SKILL.md 只是供 AI Agent 使用的配套组件，两者不应被当作同一种交付物。

question.en: Can the Skill run a browser by itself?
question.zh: 单靠这个 Skill 能操作浏览器吗？

answer.en: No. The CLI performs navigation, snapshots, and interactions. The Skill tells the agent which CLI-served workflow to read first.
answer.zh: 不能。导航、快照和交互由 CLI 执行；Skill 只告诉 Agent 先读取哪一份由 CLI 提供的流程。
